key.name: first-run
key.description: Whether the application has not yet completed its first run (used to show a welcome/greeting flow).

key.name: last-identity
key.description: Identifier of the certificate identity that was used for the most recent connection attempt. Empty means no identity has been used yet.

key.name: server-list
key.description: Favorite Mumble servers. Each array element is one favorite serialized as a compact JSON object string with the fields "name", "host", "port", "username" and "identity-id"; e.g. {"name":"Community","host":"mumble.example.org","port":64738,"username":"alice","identity-id":"sha256:..."}. Entries that fail to parse are skipped on load.

key.name: audio-input-device
key.description: Identifier of the capture (microphone) device to use. Empty means the system default device.

key.name: audio-output-device
key.description: Identifier of the playback device to use. Empty means the system default device.

key.name: vad-threshold
key.description: Microphone level above which voice is transmitted, as a position on the level meter: 0.0 is -60 dBFS, 1.0 is 0 dBFS (default 0.35 ≈ -39 dBFS). Lower values are more sensitive.

key.name: jitter-target-frames
key.description: Audio buffered per incoming speaker before playback starts, in 10 ms frames (2–8, i.e. 20–80 ms). Larger values tolerate more network jitter at the cost of latency.

key.name: audio-packet-frames
key.description: Outgoing audio per voice packet in 10 ms frames: 1, 2, 4 or 6 (10, 20, 40 or 60 ms). Larger packets need less bandwidth but add latency. The official Mumble client defaults to 20 ms.

key.name: audio-quality
key.description: Opus bitrate for outgoing voice in kbit/s (32–192). Servers with a lower bandwidth limit reduce it automatically.

key.name: notification-enabled
key.description: Whether to show desktop notifications for events such as incoming private messages or user joins while the window is unfocused.

key.name: notify-channel-presence
key.summary: Notify when users enter or leave my channel
key.description: Show a desktop notification when another user joins or leaves the channel you are in. Requires notification-enabled.

key.name: notify-server-presence
key.summary: Notify when users connect to or disconnect from the server
key.description: Show a desktop notification when another user connects to or disconnects from the server. Requires notification-enabled.

key.name: sounds-enabled
key.description: Whether to play sounds for connection, channel and message events.

key.name: sound-events
key.description: Overrides of the sound played per event (e.g. "user-joined-channel"). Values: "off", "builtin:<id>" or "file:<path>" (WAV or Ogg Vorbis). Events without an entry use their built-in default.

key.name: auto-reconnect
key.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect to the server after an unexpected disconnection.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the main window in pixels, saved on close and restored on startup.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the main window in pixels, saved on close and restored on startup.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized when it was last closed.
